description.zh:
处于waiting状态的策略任务ID。
>调用[DescribeSoarStrategyTasks](~~2837958~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the policy task that is in the waiting state.
>Call the [DescribeSoarStrategyTasks](~~2837958~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

descriptions.zh: 仅云安全中心的企业版和旗舰版支持该API调用，其他版本不支持。
descriptions.en: Only the Enterprise and Ultimate editions of Security Center support this API call. Other editions are not supported.
